description: This Java class, CreateInterestPauseCommandHandler, is a command handler within the Fineract project. It processes requests to create interest pauses for loans, handling parameters such as start and end dates, and determining whether to identify the loan by internal ID or external ID.

classes.name: CreateInterestPauseCommandHandler
classes.description: A command handler class responsible for creating interest pauses for loans, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JsonCommand to create an interest pause, extracting parameters and invoking the interestPauseService accordingly. Throws a validation exception if neither loan ID nor external ID is provided.
